name: Pre-Ride Anxiety Release
description: Calm your nerves before getting in the saddle
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Start with the Karate Chop point on the side of your hand. Tap gently while saying: "Even though I feel nervous about this ride, I deeply and completely accept myself." Continue tapping through the sequence: Eyebrow, Side of Eye, Under Eye, Under Nose, Under Mouth, Collarbone, Under Arm, Top of Head. At each point, acknowledge your feelings: "This nervousness... This anxiety... I choose to feel calm and confident... I am safe... My horse and I are a team." Complete 2-3 rounds until you feel more centered.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT) research, bilateral stimulation from EMDR, and acupressure-based interventions.

name: Fear of Falling Reset
description: Release fear and build confidence after a fall or scary moment
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Begin at the Karate Chop point, tapping while saying: "Even though I have this fear of falling, I am safe right now." Move through the points: Eyebrow - "This fear in my body..." Side of Eye - "This worry about falling..." Under Eye - "Feeling unsafe..." Under Nose - "This fear..." Under Mouth - "I choose to feel grounded..." Collarbone - "I am learning and growing..." Under Arm - "My body knows how to balance..." Top of Head - "I trust myself and my horse." Repeat until fear diminishes.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT) research, bilateral stimulation from EMDR, and acupressure-based interventions.

Collarbone - "My body can release this..." Under Arm - "I choose peace..." Top of Head - "I am healing." Go slowly, breathe deeply. Repeat as needed over several sessions.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
